describes: packages/core/main: the microtask turn on which each document transition and the kernel teardown settle, measured with the runner's turn meter.

cases.name: open-settles-on-its-turn
cases.covers: open() resolves on the turn TypeScript's does: the operation's `.finally` takes three turns after the open body, and the `async` openDocument wrapper two more to adopt it.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` falls among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: a-failed-open-rejects-on-its-turn
cases.covers: The same turns on the failure path: the rollback, then the `.finally` and the adoption.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` falls among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: a-throwing-thunk-rejects-on-its-turn
cases.covers: A thunk source that throws synchronously never reaches `engineCall`: the open fails in its own turn, then the `.finally` and the adoption.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` falls among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: unlock-settles-on-its-turn
cases.covers: unlock() is an `async` function returning the operation, so it adopts it in two turns, like open().
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` falls among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: retry-settles-on-its-turn
cases.covers: retry() closes the failed tab, then returns openDocument's promise from an `async` arrow: the open's turns plus one adoption.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` falls among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: close-joins-a-thunk-open-on-its-turn
cases.covers: close() while a thunk source is pending: the open rejects after its `.finally` and adoption, and close joins the operation with `await operation?.catch(...)`, two turns, before it disposes the scope and emits `closed`.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` and the listener fall among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: destroy-joins-start-on-its-turn
cases.covers: destroy() after a settled start: `await startPromise?.catch(...)` is two turns before the workspace scope disposes.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` and the teardown fall among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: close-joins-an-open-on-its-turn
cases.covers: close() during pages.list: the open rejects after its `.finally` and adoption, and close joins the operation with `await operation?.catch(...)`, two turns, before it disposes the scope and emits `closed`.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` and the listener fall among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: close-joins-a-pending-policy-on-its-turn
cases.covers: Close joins the pending policy read; when it settles the open rejects cancelled and close emits closed on their measured turns.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: where @@settled and closed fall among @@turn callbacks.

cases.name: close-of-a-ready-document-on-its-turn
cases.covers: close() with no operation in flight: `await session.operation?.catch(...)` on null is one turn.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` and the listener fall among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: destroy-closes-a-document-on-its-turn
cases.covers: destroy() with a document open: the start join, then the session close, whose scope awaits `handle.close()`, an `AbortablePromise` that `await` adopts in three turns, then the workspace scope.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` and the teardowns fall among the `@@turn` callbacks.

cases.name: bring-up-awaits-the-render-policy-on-its-turn
cases.covers: Bring-up awaits the raw render.getPolicy AbortablePromise before constructing document plugins.
cases.reason: Pins turn counts: what matters is where `@@settled` and create falls among the `@@turn` callbacks.
